afterImage.description: Mission Clean Energy LLC is a U.S. utility-scale solar and battery-storage development platform headquartered in San Francisco. Mission develops large projects through subsidiary and project-level entities; approximately 1 GW of Midwest battery projects were described as Mission-owned development assets, while broader multi-gigawatt figures represent the development pipeline rather than operating capacity. Wafra announced the acquisition of a controlling interest in October 2022, and Mission continues to identify an affiliate of Wafra-managed funds as its principal investor. Orsted completed a separate strategic minority investment in December 2024. Exact Wafra and Orsted percentages, Wafra's fund and legal vehicle, and any current founder or API ownership are not publicly disclosed. No platform exit or signed pending platform transfer was identified through the reviewed cutoff.
